basic_info.description: Experience San Francisco's most dynamic neighborhood in this bright, contemporary three-bedroom condo perfectly positioned between Alamo Square, Hayes Valley, and Duboce Triangle. Outside your door, everything that defines modern San Francisco living is a leisurely walk away: sunrise pour-overs at Cafe Reveille, meadow lounging in Alamo Square, boutique shopping along Hayes Street, Michelin-inspired dinners at Zuni, and live sets at the SFJAZZ Center  no car needed. Inside, discover an open concept living space flooded with natural light, featuring a chef's kitchen that flows seamlessly into the main living area. The thoughtful layout maximizes every square foot while providing ample storage throughout. Three well appointed bedrooms provide flexible living options, whether you need a dedicated workspace, nursery, or guest accommodations. Direct access to a spectacular garden oasis complete with mature citrus trees-a rare urban sanctuary to escape the city buzz without leaving home. This outdoor retreat offers the perfect spot for alfresco dinners, weekend gatherings, or simply unwinding under your own piece of sky. With dining, tech shuttle stops, and three iconic parks moments away, this home captures urban living at its finest-  sophisticated connected, and surprisingly serene.
